info.title: Ezkey Admin API
info.description:
Administration API for Ezkey - Open Source MFA/Passkey Alternative

This API enables administrative management of Ezkey's main entities:
- **Integrations**: Applications or systems protected by MFA
- **Enrollments**: Associations between users, devices and integrations
- **Auth Attempts**: MFA authentication attempts
- **Admin Management**: Administrator authentication,
                        enrollment recovery, and admin operations

The API follows REST conventions and uses DTOs for all requests and responses.

post.summary: Wait for passwordless authentication device response
post.description: Polls device for passwordless authentication response in two-call flows. Blocks for up to 5 minutes waiting for device approval. Supports both challenge-based (with display code) and non-blocking flows. Errors follow RFC 9457 Problem Details format.

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns bearer token and admin session details.

400.description: Bad Request - Device denied, signature failed, or challenge invalid. Returns RFC 9457 ProblemDetail with specific error type URI.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid challenge code. Returns RFC 9457 ProblemDetail: type='...invalid-credentials'

408.description: Request Timeout - No device response within 5-minute window. Returns RFC 9457 ProblemDetail: type='...auth-timeout'

post.summary: Authenticate administrator with passwordless Ezkey MFA
post.description: Passwordless authentication for administrators using device-based cryptography. Supports single-call (blocking) or two-call (challenge) flows. Returns bearer token on success, or challenge info for two-step authentication. Rate limiting applied per IP. Errors follow RFC 9457 Problem Details format.

200.description: Authentication successful or pending. If status='approved', bearer token is present. If status='pending', authAttemptId and challengeCode present for two-call flow.

400.description: Bad Request - Authentication failed with temporal issues (expired, rejected, invalid signature). Returns RFC 9457 ProblemDetail with specific error type URI.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid credentials (username not found). Returns RFC 9457 ProblemDetail: type='...invalid-credentials'

403.description: Forbidden - Account inactive or no device enrolled. Returns RFC 9457 ProblemDetail: type='...account-inactive' or '...no-enrollment'

408.description: Request Timeout - No device response within 5 minutes. Returns RFC 9457 ProblemDetail: type='...auth-timeout'

429.description: Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded for this IP address. Applies after 10 failed attempts in 15 minutes.

get.summary: Verify integrity of a single audit log entry
get.description: Recomputes the HMAC-SHA256 signature for a single audit log entry and compares it to the stored value. Returns OK if the entry is intact, INTEGRITY_VIOLATION_DETECTED if modified, UNSIGNED if not signed, or NOT_FOUND if the ID does not exist. Global Admin only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Audit log entry ID to verify

get.description: Recomputes HMAC-SHA256 signatures for audit log entries in the specified date range and reports any tampered or unsigned entries. Global Admin only.
Verifies chain checkpoint integrity by recomputing entry digests and validating chain linkage. Detects entry insertion, deletion, reordering, and checkpoint tampering. Global Admin only.
